content: {"question":"If a GitLab employee moves from the PTY LTD Australia office to the GitLab BV Belgium office, how does the amount and carry‑over policy of their paid annual leave change?","answer":"They would switch from 4 weeks of paid annual leave that accrues and can carry over year to year to 20 statutory vacation days that are front‑loaded and do not carry over to the next calendar year.","evidence_a":"Full‑time team members are entitled to 4 weeks paid annual leave in accordance with the Fair Work Act 2009 (Cth) per year of continuous service. Annual leave accrues progressively and accumulates from year to year.","evidence_b":"20 statutory days, front‑loaded annually for full‑time team members and does not carry over to the next calendar year"}
